high_level_description: The image features a logo with a minimalist design set against a black background. The logo consists of three main elements: Left Element: A curved line that starts from the top left, curves downward, and then back up to the right. This line transitions through a gradient of colors, starting from a bright pink at the top, blending into purple, and ending in blue at the bottom. Middle Element: A straight vertical line that is white and stands upright between the two curved lines. It is positioned centrally and is the tallest element in the logo.
